caveats: Two full-suite single-seed outcomes do not complete the broader multi-seed research program.
Partial and recovery outcomes are never interpreted as full-suite scores.
E9 legacy Tinker and merged-vLLM arms remain separate; heterogeneous competition scores are not averaged.
The first Spooky Author run retains only a submission preview; its complete submission is missing. A later same-program run has its complete submission.
Colab source-pin preflight for the alternative public portfolio does not evaluate the contracted E1-E14 suites.
Historical Colab canaries failed with out-of-memory and CUDA illegal-memory-access errors; they produced no suite result.
Provider trust, licenses, decontamination, full-suite execution and checkpoint gates still apply before any paid continuation.
